tips.title: Moderation tips
tips.rejectTitle: Reject the concert if it meets at least one of these conditions:
rejectItems: Non grata festival: festivals associated with bad actors (Superstruct, KKR) or with unethical business practices (charging re-entry fees, exploiting bar staff). Examples: Viña Rock, Resurrection, Tsunami.
Mainstream festivals: pop events already have more than enough publicity and occupy space on other platforms, preppies go to Mad Cool.
Fascist artist: one of the bands promotes fascism (racism, sexism, lgbtiphobia, etc.), hate speech, or is clearly far-right. Examples: Sherpa, nazi bands.
Malicious concert: the event contains misleading data. Examples: a URL that doesn't lead to the event, announces bands that aren't playing to attract attention.
The festival poster explicitly requests it not be shared, common in events organised in social centres (CSOs).
tips.requestChangesTitle: Request changes from the user in these cases:
requestChangesItems: There are identifiable errors in the data.
There is a discrepancy between the submitted data and the real data (on the poster or at the URL).
hideItems: The event is a duplicate of one already approved.
The festival poster explicitly requests it not be shared, common in events organised in social centres (CSOs).
It is not suitable for approval for other reasons.
